evals.prompt: Perform a performance audit of the codebase in the current working directory. Return the full report.
evals.expected_output: A Performance Audit Report with findings ordered by priority (P1 first), each carrying a hot-path citation, a back-of-envelope estimate, and impact/effort labels; cold-code inefficiencies listed as one-line notes, not findings.

assertions.text: Report contains a Summary section that names the hot paths and the single best quick win
Findings appear in priority order: all P1 findings before P2, P2 before P3, P3 before P4
Each finding heading carries a priority tag of the form [P1] through [P4]
Each finding has a Category from: Algorithms, I/O and Round Trips, Allocation and Copies, Redundant Work, Data Layout, Observability Overhead
Each finding cites at least one file path with a line number
Each finding's Hot path field names the loop, handler, or caller that multiplies the cost, with a file:line citation
Each finding's Estimate field contains arithmetic (cost per operation times frequency) with stated assumptions, marked as an estimate
Each finding has an Impact label (High/Medium/Low) and an Effort label (Small/Medium/Large/Architectural) consistent with its priority per the matrix
Inefficiencies in startup, config, CLI, test, or one-shot migration code do not appear as findings; they appear (if at all) as one-line entries in Cold-Code Notes
Report contains a Cold-Code Notes section and a Not Found section
No finding flags code whose cost the report cannot tie to a named hot path or documented frequency
